questions.subject: Reasoning & Intelligence
questions.text: Select the related word pair: Odometer : Mileage :: Barometer : ?
questions.explanation: An odometer measures mileage traveled; a barometer measures atmospheric pressure.

questions.subject: Reasoning & Intelligence
questions.text: Find the missing number in the sequence: 4, 9, 25, 49, 121, ?
questions.explanation: The sequence consists of squares of consecutive prime numbers: 2², 3², 5², 7², 11², and the next prime is 13² = 169.

questions.subject: Reasoning & Intelligence
questions.text: If in a certain code, "ROAD" is written as "URDG", how is "SWAN" written in that same code?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted by +3: S(+3)->V, W(+3)->Z, A(+3)->D, N(+3)->Q. Hence, VZDQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning & Intelligence
questions.text: Kavya walks 10 m North, turns right and walks 6 m, then turns right again and walks 10 m. How far is she from her starting point?
questions.explanation: Moving North 10m then South 10m cancels the vertical displacement. She is 6m East of the starting point.

questions.subject: Reasoning & Intelligence
questions.text: Pointing to a gentleman, Ananya says: "His only brother is the father of my daughter's father." How is the gentleman related to Ananya?
questions.explanation: Daughter's father = Ananya's husband. Father of her husband = Father-in-law. The gentleman is the brother of her father-in-law.

questions.subject: Reasoning & Intelligence
questions.text: Statements: All mangoes are fruits. All fruits are sweet. Conclusion I: All mangoes are sweet. Conclusion II: All sweet things are mangoes.
questions.explanation: All mangoes are inside fruits, and all fruits are inside sweet. Thus all mangoes are definitely sweet. Conclusion I holds.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.text: Which Article of the Constitution of India guarantees the Right to Equality before Law?
questions.textTe: భారత రాజ్యాంగంలోని ఏ అధికరణ చట్టం ముందు సమానత్వాన్ని హామీ ఇస్తుంది?
questions.textHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद कानून के समक्ष समानता की गारंटी देता है?
questions.explanation: Article 14 provides that the State shall not deny to any person equality before the law or equal protection of laws within India.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.text: Who presided over the historic 1929 Lahore Session of the Indian National Congress where "Purna Swaraj" was declared?
questions.textTe: "పూర్ణ స్వరాజ్" ప్రకటించబడిన 1929 చారిత్రక లాహోర్ కాంగ్రెస్ సమావేశానికి ఎవరు అధ్యక్షత వహించారు?
questions.textHi: 1929 के ऐतिहासिक लाहौर कांग्रेस अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता किसने की थी जिसमें "पूर्ण स्वराज" की घोषणा की गई थी?
questions.explanation: Jawaharlal Nehru presided over the Lahore session in December 1929, adopting the resolution for complete independence (Purna Swaraj).

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.text: Which is the longest river flowing entirely within the Indian peninsula?
questions.textTe: భారత ద్వీపకల్పంలో ప్రవహించే అతి పొడవైన నది ఏది?
questions.textHi: भारतीय प्रायद्वीप में बहने वाली सबसे लंबी नदी कौन सी है?
questions.explanation: Godavari, also known as "Dakshin Ganga", is the longest peninsular river with a length of approx. 1,465 km.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.text: Which blood group is universally recognized as the universal donor in the ABO and Rh system?
questions.textTe: ABO మరియు Rh విధానంలో సార్వత్రిక దాతగా పిలువబడే రక్త వర్గం ఏది?
questions.textHi: ABO और Rh प्रणाली में किस रक्त समूह को सार्वभौमिक दाता माना जाता है?

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.text: Which Article of the Constitution of India guarantees the Right to Equality before Law?
questions.textTe: భారత రాజ్యాంగంలోని ఏ అధికరణ చట్టం ముందు సమానత్వాన్ని హామీ ఇస్తుంది?
questions.textHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद कानून के समक्ष समानता की गारंटी देता है?
questions.explanation: Article 14 provides that the State shall not deny to any person equality before the law or equal protection of laws within India.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.text: Who presided over the historic 1929 Lahore Session of the Indian National Congress where "Purna Swaraj" was declared?
questions.textTe: "పూర్ణ స్వరాజ్" ప్రకటించబడిన 1929 చారిత్రక లాహోర్ కాంగ్రెస్ సమావేశానికి ఎవరు అధ్యక్షత వహించారు?
questions.textHi: 1929 के ऐतिहासिक लाहौर कांग्रेस अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता किसने की थी जिसमें "पूर्ण स्वराज" की घोषणा की गई थी?
questions.explanation: Jawaharlal Nehru presided over the Lahore session in December 1929, adopting the resolution for complete independence (Purna Swaraj).

questions.text: Which is the longest river flowing entirely within the Indian peninsula?
questions.textTe: భారత ద్వీపకల్పంలో ప్రవహించే అతి పొడవైన నది ఏది?
questions.textHi: भारतीय प्रायद्वीप में बहने वाली सबसे लंबी नदी कौन सी है?
questions.explanation: Godavari, also known as "Dakshin Ganga", is the longest peninsular river with a length of approx. 1,465 km.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.text: Which blood group is universally recognized as the universal donor in the ABO and Rh system?
questions.textTe: ABO మరియు Rh విధానంలో సార్వత్రిక దాతగా పిలువబడే రక్త వర్గం ఏది?
questions.textHi: ABO और Rh प्रणाली में किस रक्त समूह को सार्वभौमिक दाता माना जाता है?
questions.explanation: O-negative red blood cells lack A, B, and Rh antigens, allowing transfusion to patients of almost any blood group in emergencies.
